name: cal_2x11_v5d
notes:
cal_2x11_v5d - 2026-08-13. FINAL, BENCH-CUT AND LOCKED. The operating profile. Cells 3 and 4 were placed by hand in pimd_delaycal v1.49 Manual Nudge against live target charts, not solved to a voltage target; the delays below are the placements, and threshold_v records the voltages they were measured to sample. NEXT STEP: BUILD THE CORPUS against this profile.

LINEAGE. cal_2x11_v5a -> v5b (top anchor 2.4 V -> 4.7 V, ladder re-cut, bench-locked) -> v5c -> v5d. Against v5b, only cells 3 and 4 moved, both earlier on both bands:
  100 us band  cell 3  12.704 -> 12.136 (-568 ns)   cell 4  13.872 -> 13.272 (-600 ns)   cell 5  15.064 -> 15.088 (+24 ns)
   10 us band  cell 2   8.384 ->  8.376 (  -8 ns)   cell 3   9.648 ->  9.088 (-560 ns)   cell 4  10.776 -> 10.160 (-616 ns)
Cells 1, 2 and 6-11 are unchanged from v5b, which carried 6-11 unchanged from v5a. Geometry, band frequencies, pulse widths and averages are unchanged throughout.

WHY CELLS 3 AND 4 MOVED EARLIER. On v5b the steepest part of the measured target response sat in the cell 2 -> cell 3 gap, and cell 3 was placed past the knee, so the response curve read as a kink rather than a shape. Moving both cells earlier puts them on that limb. The gaps become 1.936 / 0.744 / 1.136 / 1.816 us on the 100 us band and 1.880 / 0.712 / 1.072 / 1.800 us on the 10 us - deliberately uneven, tight through the knee and wide either side, which is the opposite of v5b's even-in-log-amplitude ladder and is the point of the change.

MEASURED IN AIR, 3 932 sweeps over 220 s, zero flagged rows, at pack 20.70 V and board 49.0 C (session_20260813_193503, fw v4.37, classviz v1.79):
  cell  100 us delay / mean     10 us delay / mean     cross-band
   1     9.456 us  4685.8 mV     6.496 us  4698.4 mV     0.27 %
   2    11.392 us  1880.0 mV     8.376 us  1901.7 mV     1.15 %
   3    12.136 us  1136.8 mV     9.088 us  1153.4 mV     1.45 %
   4    13.272 us   491.4 mV    10.160 us   507.2 mV     3.16 %
   5    15.088 us   123.2 mV    11.960 us   124.5 mV     1.13 %
   6    15.872 us    78.8 mV    12.896 us    78.1 mV     0.98 %
   7    16.920 us    62.2 mV    13.800 us    70.0 mV    11.77 %  (null minimum, band-dependent by construction)
   8    21.160 us    91.6 mV    16.160 us    92.0 mV     0.38 %

Air std dev 0.07-1.03 mV per cell on the 100 us band and 0.07-0.25 mV on the 10 us. Sweep rate 17.86 Hz, unchanged from v5a/v5b as expected - the geometry did not change.

KNOWN WART, NOT CORRECTED: cell 4's cross-band matching is 3.16 %, against 0.26 % on v5b. The hand placement moved the two bands by slightly different amounts (-600 vs -616 ns) on a steep part of the decay. Cells 1-5 are supposed to be amplitude-matched across bands so that cell index n means the same point on the decay in either band, and cell 4 is the one that now bends that. Left as cut - this profile is locked. If it is ever revisited, ~20 ns on either band closes it.

MEASURED AT A LOW PACK. This cut and these voltages were taken at pack 20.70 V, below the pack state v5b was cut at (21.6 V) and near the bottom of the DESIGN section 12 clean window. Amplitude moves 43-51 mV/V with pack state, so the cells will read HIGHER than the table above on a fuller pack - roughly +150 to +200 mV on cell 1 at 24 V. Cell 1 at 4.686 V is 94 % of the 5.000 V ADC full scale, so on a fresh pack it will sit near 4.85 V. Not clipping, but cell 1 wants watching at the top of the pack range; if it clips, the top anchor has to come down and the ladder be re-cut.

EARLY DELAY. Cell 1 sits at 6.496 / 9.456 us, earlier than anything used before v5b and earlier than the ~9-12 us window the scope captures cover, so the front-end transient is not independently characterised there. It measures clean - 0.25 / 0.93 mV air std dev, 0.27 % cross-band agreement.

VALIDATED OFFLINE against the firmware's own compute_pulse_duties / pulse_duties_valid: every delay an exact multiple of the 8 ns PWM grid, every (drive_duty, sample_duty) pair inside 16 bits with sample strictly after drive, delays strictly increasing and threshold_v strictly descending. The 10 us band's last cell keeps 96 ns of margin (157 counts).

threshold_v - MIXED MEANING. Cells 1-5 carry REAL measured amplitudes in volts, rounded from the cross-band means above: 4.700 / 1.900 / 1.150 / 0.500 / 0.125. These are what pimd_delaycal keys its nudge targets on, and they are pack-state dependent as described. Cells 6-11 are time-anchored and band-dependent, so their entries are PLACEHOLDER ORDERING KEYS ONLY - 100 / 90 / 80 / 70 / 60 / 50 mV, chosen only to keep the column strictly descending. Do not mine cells 6-11 as voltages; the null minimum measures 62.2 / 70.0 mV, not 90.

GEOMETRY PIN. Any edit to this file - including this notes text - changes profile_sha8 and therefore the (profile_name, profile_sha8) comparability guard in pimd_features. Frames recorded under a different sha8 must never be mixed with corpus rows recorded under this one (DESIGN section 10). Reload the profile in the tool before recording, so the corpus is stamped against the locked file.
